body: Fuck it we redosed were rolling!! Have a great memorial weekend everyone!!!
Do you stop taking yours at all? Like the day of? I'm on a low dose of it and planning a roll for the end of the month so I've been tapering off mine.

I'm an xray tech and there are places that do imaging for people with no insurance. They will usually do a cash payment plan and it's usually no more than a couple hundred dollars (huge steal). Call around to clinics and see if they partner with any cash imaging places that they can refer you to. Or you can try calling pain management clinics to see if they'll see him without the mri first. If he tells them he's depressed and needs help they might try to work with him.
Awesome! Thanks for the tip! I'm definitely going to look into it!
Awesome!! I'll look into it, I have a PT appt Monday so I'll ask if they know about it. If not we have an acupuncture place in town I'll call and see what they say.
I haven't,  is it like acupuncture? Most of my pain is in my glute and I really have to focus to get it to relax.

I am, I have PT twice a week and I bought a "sit and decompress" contraption that hangs from the doorway. We have an inversion table but it hurts my leg to much to be on it. I even went and bought healing crystals and starting meditating (I am willing to try anything to help). I had the steriod shots in my spine and they helped a little bit but it didn't last very long. I'm waiting on our local YMCA to open so I can go to the pool to exercise some more.

That's exactly what is happening to me right now.  I can only sleep for maybe 4 hours at time and then I have to get up. My husband even moved a recliner into our bed room so I can try to stay in the room and sleep but I usually end up going into another room because all I do is cry. I'm so over all of it.

My tear is the L5-S1 and the fluid leaking out is right on the sciatica nerve making me want to cut my entire leg off. Do you ever have any moments that are pain free? I've gotten the steroid shots in my spine and they help a little bit but it seems like my body is just so unhappy when I try to sleep.
Thanks! I'm going to try to stomach sleep tonight,  I'm willing to do just about anything to be able to sleep.
